tasks.prompt: You recently organized a speech competition at your university where Professor Kawu served as one of the judges. The event went smoothly, but you hope to attract more participants when you hold the event again next year.
bullets: ●  Describe what you plan to do to attract more participants.
●  Suggest a meeting to get his advice.
tasks.subject: Appreciation and project successes

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: We’ve been discussing the concept of social mobility. Some experts argue that attaining a higher education is the key to improving social mobility, while others believe that universal access to quality healthcare and social services plays a more crucial role. Which factor do you think is more important for enhancing social mobility? Why?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I think higher education is more important for enhancing social mobility. A college degree can open doors to better job opportunities and higher earnings, which can significantly improve one’s social and economic status over time.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: In my opinion, access to quality healthcare and social services is more crucial. Without good health and basic support, individuals may struggle to pursue education and career opportunities. Ensuring that everyone has access to these services can create a more level playing field.
